entities.summary: The Āzādi Sport Complex, formerly known as Āryāmehr Sports Complex, is the national sports complex of Iran, located in Tehran. The Azadi Stadium was located within the walls of this complex. It was designed by Abdol-Aziz Mirza Farmanfarmaian along with the San Francisco office of Skidmore, Owings, & Merrill, and constructed by Iran's Arme Construction Company.
